text:
vikram: Heads-up — AMS customs flagged a partial hold on PO R-23877, manifest below. Carrier says ETA unclear (could be 48-96h).
orion-supply: Confirmed receipt of notice. We're pinging customs broker now, should have more clarity by EOD.
maya: Which customer is this for? We might need to offer a short-term bump or swap if Dedicated commits are impacted.
vikram: This batch is part of Q3 Dedicated commits for 'EdgeStream' (40% of their reserved units). If delays >72h we risk SLA exposure.
liam: Can we ask the carrier to RTD to FRA and do EU cross-dock? Might be faster than waiting on customs in AMS.
sophia: EdgeStream is in pre-prod ramp; they already accepted a partial allocation but expect the reserved capacity. If there's a swap we should notify the sales lead.
jordan: Procurement asked partner for any alternate PODs. We also have a small EUR buffer (PO R-24001) sitting in FRA that could cover ~8 GPUs.
orion-supply: FRA buffer exists but it's not identical SKU — would need a quick re-quant and compat check. ETA to reconfigure ~6-8h if approved.
vikram: OK timeline check — customs broker ETA 12:00 UTC. If unresolved, propose: 1) route AMS -> FRA cross-dock (carrier effort), 2) soft-swap FRA buffer to EdgeStream and backfill with next inbound. Which option is fastest?
liam: Routing AMS->FRA will add 10-18h transit + customs at FRA. If broker can clear docs in 24h it's faster to wait. Risk assessment: swap introduces extra ops and variant checks.
maya: From partnerships POV, call partner ops and request priority clearance + docs scan. Also ask SI to accept temporary SKU variance if possible (notify SI: @edge-si-team).
sophia: I'll message EdgeStream sales/PM right now with a heads-up and proposed mitigation. Want to avoid surprise during their demo next week.
jordan: If we go swap route, need formal PO change + manifest amendment. I can prep the change order template now: `CHANGE-ORDER R-23877 -> R-24001 (temp swap)`.
vikram: Sharing manifest snippet for clarity:
```
Manifest R-23877
- 12 x NVIDIA A100-80GB (model A100-80)
- 4 x NVIDIA T4 (model T4-16)
Carrier: EuFreight #EF-9921
Customs ref: CUST-AMS-5543
```
orion-bot: [shipment-tracker] status update: EF-9921 held at AMS customs (docs pending). Next automated check: 11:45 UTC.
orion-supply: Broker asked for commercial invoice clarification. Sending updated invoice now.
liam: If broker clears by 12:00 UTC we stand down on swap. If not, I'll contact carrier ops to request immediate RTD to FRA; need approval to incur re-route fees.
maya: Approve up to €4k re-route fees for this incident to avoid SLA breach (cc: finance). Please include cost recovery plan in customer comms.
vikram: Thanks. Action items: - jordan: draft change order if swap needed - liam: standby for RTD + cost notify - orion-supply: chase broker docs - sophia: comms to EdgeStream - maya: flag partner ops to escalate
sophia: Noted. I'll draft a short note for EdgeStream: explanation + expected windows + offer small credit if demo impacted.
orion-supply: Broker says additional paperwork uploaded. They will confirm clearance/no later than 11:50 UTC.
vikram: Great — keep thread updated. If we don't hear by 12:05 UTC, move to swap plan and jordan files the change order.
maya: thanks all :thumbsup!
